content:
maria (sec): Uploaded pen test excerpt — finding #12: token replay allows reusing bearer for actions that trigger KMS decrypt. Also noted lack of KMS audit events in prod account. Need triage + retest window.

aj (eng-sre): Can you paste the repro steps / curl? Also which env (prod/us-west-2?)

maria (sec): Repro ->
```
# attacker replays captured token
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $STOLEN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"prompt":"get secret"}'
```
Works when token not expired. Auth middleware doesn't check jti/nonce.

liam (eng-runtime): I reproduced locally. jti not validated because jwt cache was disabled in older deploy. Opening PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4128

zoe (eng-security): Pen tester flagged missing CloudTrail events for KMS:Decrypt — we need audit evidence before retest. Is CloudTrail data events enabled for KMS? If not, severity stays high.

sam (infra): CloudTrail in prod had management events only. Not enabled data events for KMS or S3. I created INFRA-4523 to enable data logging and added baseline policy. ETA 24h.

maria (sec): Also need proof HSM/KMS won't allow key export. Pen asked for KMS key policy and rotation state. I'll attach key ARN and policy after this thread.

liam (eng-runtime): PR merged, canary deploy in us-west-2 now. deploy-bot: canary deploy completed (svc=auth, tag=pr-4128, status=green)

qa (support): Running retest steps on canary. After INFRA-4523 changes, CloudTrail shows KMS:Decrypt events. Sample log:
```
{
  "eventVersion": "1.08",
  "eventSource": "kms.amazonaws.com",
  "eventName": "Decrypt",
  "userIdentity": {"type":"AssumedRole","arn":"arn:aws:sts::123:assumed-role/redwood-prod/AuthRole"},
  "requestParameters": {"keyId":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/abcd-1234"}
}
```
We also couldn't reproduce a token replay granting extra privileges — token replay hits auth reject now.

zoe (eng-security): Given patch + audit evidence, propose lowering severity to medium. Confirm with pen tester.

maria (sec): I'll send summary + logs to pen-tester (PEN-2187) and request verification. Target retest: Fri EOD. I'll post updates.

deploy-bot: Ticket PEN-2187 annotated: evidence attached, retest requested.

aj (eng-sre): Thanks team — keep channel updated. :thumbsup:
